news.title: New Diamond Website out now
news.text: The brand new DiamondTier website is live.
news.article: The new DiamondTier website is out now. It has a fresh look, a podium for the top players, a main tierlist and a separate subtiers list, tournaments, and a built-in AI that can answer questions about any player on the list. We'll keep adding news and features here, so check back often.

news.title: New Diamond Tiertagger coming out soon!
news.text: A new version of the DiamondTier Tags mod is on the way.
news.article: The DiamondTier Tags mod shows a player's tier above their head in game and has an in-game menu to look up players and view your own tiers. A new Diamond Tiertagger is coming out soon. It is currently waiting on review for Modrinth and CurseForge, and we'll post here as soon as it is live.

news.title: Trident subtier added
news.text: Trident is now part of the subtiers lineup.
